messages:
Oncall Bot: PAGER: sev2 - increased inference errors and 5xx rate on dedicated clusters in us-east-1. Triggered at 03:02 UTC. Paging alex.
Alex Chen: I'm on it. grabbing logs and prometheus graphs now. source looks like sudden error spikes from runtime v4.3.1-quant.
Priya Singh: saw an alert on KV-cache miss ratio skyrocketing earlier. could be cache pressure after the quant rollout.
Mateo Rivera: I can help with routing/fallbacks. can we switch traffic to the non-quant variant temporarily?
Alex Chen: yes. initiating canary rollback to v4.3.0-nonquant for dedicated-us-east-*. doing gradual 20% -> 50% -> 100% if metrics look okay.
deploy-bot: rollback job started: jobs/rl-2690011223-rollback. logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/jobs/rl-2690011223
Jordan Kim: FYI customers A and C reported increased latency and occasional hallucinations. CS already notified. doing impact assessment now.
Priya Singh: running quick health checks on KV cache. snippet:```
rctl kvcache stats --pool=dedicated-us-east-1
# looking for high evictions, memory pressure
```
Priya Singh: results: evictions spiking, avg ttl reduced, write amplification up 3x. suspect quant kernels reduce effective cache hit rate for some sequences.
Alex Chen: Mateo, can you reroute latency-sensitive routes to non-quant model? add a policy override for the next 2 hours.
Mateo Rivera: done. policy: route:prod-text-gen -> fallback:model=v4.3.0-nonquant, reason: emergency rollback.
Alex Chen: also disabling aggressive batching on affected nodes to reduce KV churn: set BATCH_MAX=8 -> 2. applying via runtime flags.
Priya Singh: applied. monitoring. initial error rate dropping at 03:14 UTC after 40% rollback and batching change.
SRE Pager: nice. what's next on mitigation checklist?
Alex Chen: short term: complete rollback to non-quant, disable aggressive batching, flush problematic KV shards if still high eviction.
Priya Singh: request: do NOT flush entire cache unless confirmed - we'll evict specific hot shards. plan: identify top 10 hot prefixes and evict those. command:```
rctl kvcache evict --pool=dedicated-us-east-1 --prefix=PREFIX
```
Jordan Kim: customer impact note for postmortem: CS ticket #CS-5691 created. affected customers: AcmeCorp (high traffic), NovaApps (sporadic). Jordan to compile exact request ids and time ranges.
Alex Chen: oncall handoff: I'm available for next 30 mins then handoff to Mateo. Mateo, you take lead for remediation tracking and action items.
Mateo Rivera: taking lead at 03:30 UTC. will create tracking board and JIRA.
Alex Chen: +1. also add alerting tweaks: threshold for KV eviction rate should be lower and have a transient suppression so small blips don't cascade.
Priya Singh: creating immediate followups: 1) revert quant rollout (done) 2) add kvcache eviction alert (owner: Priya) 3) adjust batching defaults (owner: Runtime Team) 4) targeted cache eviction script and validation (owner: Mateo) 5) postmortem and customer communication (owner: Jordan).
Mateo Rivera: creating JIRA INF-4812 (Inference runtime: KV cache / quant regression remediation). link: https://jira.internal/INF-4812
Mateo Rivera: adding subtasks: INF-4812-1 targeted-evict, INF-4812-2 batching-tune, INF-4812-3 quant-rollout-policy, INF-4812-4 observability-enhancements. ETA: initial triage and plan by EOD.
Jordan Kim: scheduling postmortem meeting: propose today 16:00 UTC to sync with CS for communications. ok?
Alex Chen: I can make 16:00 UTC. Priya?
Priya Singh: yes. I'll prepare root-cause notes and a short diff of config changes made during mitigation.
SRE Pager: make sure to include timeline in postmortem and mark customer-impact windows. also attach metrics graphs: p50/p95 latency, 5xx rate, KV eviction rate.
Mateo Rivera: will own tracking board and will update it with remediation status. I'll ping this thread with JIRA links and PRs.
Alex Chen: followups for now: - Mateo: create tracking board + JIRA (INF-4812) - Priya: kvcache alert + targeted-evict script - Runtime Team: batching default rollback + config change PR - Jordan: customer impact details and CS comms draft - Alex: handoff doc + verify rollback stable by 04:00 UTC
Priya Singh: quick note: avoid re-enabling quant until we have a canary that monitors KV hit rate and end-to-end quality evals. add an automated rollback if KV misses > 15% for 10m.
Jordan Kim: CS draft will state: experienced intermittent latency increases and errors during model rollout; root cause being incompatibility of quantized kernels with current kvcache usage pattern; mitigation applied: rollback to non-quant model, temporary routing updates. requesting review from legal/comms if needed.
Alex Chen: if everything looks green by 04:00 UTC I will close the pager. otherwise escalate.
SRE Pager: note for oncall handoff later: include runbook steps for targeted cache eviction, how to disable batching flags, and how to re-route traffic. add to ops runbooks repo.
Mateo Rivera: ack. creating runbook PR now. will post link here when ready.
deploy-bot: job completed: jobs/rl-2690011223-rollback -> success at 03:28 UTC.
Alex Chen: metrics stable, error rate down to baseline. I'm handing off to Mateo at 03:32 UTC. Mateo, you're primary.
Mateo Rivera: I have control. continuing with action item tracking and postmortem scheduling. will update timestamped checklist in JIRA.
Jordan Kim: CS update posted for impacted customers at 03:40 UTC.
Priya Singh: leaving notes: suspected root cause = quant kernel changes increased intermediate representation size causing KV cache key mismatches and higher eviction pressure; secondary = aggressive batching exposing hot prefixes. will validate with smaller repro and bench.
Mateo Rivera: last notes before we close: - Postmortem meeting set: 16:00 UTC today - Owner: Mateo Rivera - JIRA: INF-4812 (links to subtasks) - Action items assigned with owners and due dates in JIRA - Next steps: implement kvcache alert, adjust rollout policy for quant (canary + KV-hit gating), add automatic rollback rule.
Alex Chen: thanks team. I'm going offline for a short break. reach out if rollback flares. :thumbsup:
SRE Pager: closing pager annotation: incident mitigated, oncall handoff completed. will keep incident open until postmortem.
Mateo Rivera: I'll post the postmortem draft and tracking board link here once ready.
Jordan Kim: will attach customer logs and CS notes to the JIRA.
Priya Singh: will follow up with perf benchmarks and a small reproduction.
Mateo Rivera: update 10:42 UTC: created tracking board: https://boards.internal/redwood/INF-4812 and posted runbook PR: https://git.internal/redwood/ops/runbooks/pulls/112
Alex Chen: noted. thanks everyone.
